# Dependables — Reusable Android Libraries

> Small, focused Android libraries published at https://maven.rohittp.com.
> One artifact per concern, no kitchen-sink SDK.

## Libraries

- [remote-logger](https://rohittp.com/dependables/remote-logger): Timber tree + push-triggered uploader for Android. Zips databases, shared_prefs, datastore, and recent logs into Firebase Cloud Storage when a `dump_logs` FCM data message arrives. The same zip is exposed via `ExportZipWriter` for in-app "export my data" UIs. Device id comes from Widevine DRM (no ANDROID_ID), exposed publicly via `DeviceId.get()`.

## Source

- [GitHub](https://github.com/rohittp0/dependables)
- [Public Maven repository](https://maven.rohittp.com)
